As a global leader in construction machinery, SANY has grown into the world’s 2nd largest construction equipment manufacturer and the largest in China, delivering innovative and reliable solutions across global markets. SANY provides a wide range of equipment including cranes, road machinery, concrete machinery, port equipment, heavy-duty trucks, electric vehicles, and firefighting & rescue vehicles. In 2012, SANY strengthened its position in the concrete machinery industry through the acquisition of 100% of Putzmeister, and expanded its crane business through cooperation with Palfinger.
